detail.om: Ogeessi fayyaa haala fayyaa kee qorata.
detail.en: A doctor assesses your condition.

title.am: ወደ ቀበሌ ወይም የክፍለ ከተማ ቢሮ ይሂዱ
title.om: Gara kebeelaa ykn waajjira kiloleejiinii deemaa
title.en: Go to the kebele or sub-city office

detail.en: Ask what support exists.
Bring copies of your documents.
Some services ask for this card.

detail.om: Deeggarsi iddoo adda addaatti adda; gaafadhaa.
detail.en: Support differs by area; ask.

note.am: በአንዳንድ የመንግሥት ጤና ተቋማት በነፃ ሊሆን ይችላል፤ ይጠይቁ።
note.om: Man'a keeniyaa mootummaa tokko tokko keessatti bilisaa ta'uu danda'a; gaafadhaa.
note.en: May be free at some government health centers; ask.

estimatedTime.am: ማረጋገጫ እና ምዝገባ ከ1–2 ሰዓት፤ ካርዱ በብዙ ቀናት (ያረጋግጡ)
estimatedTime.om: Ragaan fi galmeen sa'aatii 1–2; kaardiin guyyoota booda (mirkaneessaa)
estimatedTime.en: Certificate and registration about 1–2 hours; card in days (confirm)

text.om: Ragaa fayyaa malee qindaa'inni hin kennamu
text.en: No ID card is given without the medical certificate

text.am: ማረጋገጫው የሚቆይበትን ጊዜ ይጠይቁ፤ የድሮ አይቀርብም
text.om: Ragaan yeroon isaa yoo darbe hin fudhatamu; haaraa fudhaa
text.en: Ask how long the certificate stays valid; an old one may be refused

text.am: ችግር ካለ የቤተሰብ አባል እንዲያልክዎ ይጠይቁ
text.om: Yoo gargaarsa barbaaddan nama maatii kee waliin deemu gaafadhaa
text.en: If you need help, ask a family member to accompany you
